Class ArmoredEnemy

java.lang.Object
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Entity
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.entities.Enemy
be.uantwerpen.fti.ei.geavanceerde.towerdefence.game.enemies.ArmoredEnemy
Direct Known Subclasses:
J2dArmoredEnemy
public abstract class ArmoredEnemy extends Enemy
A heavily armoured enemy — high HP, slow movement, and physical resistance.

Default stats:

  • health: 220
  • speed: 1.2 game-world units per second
  • reward: 25 gold on kill
  • score: 20 points on kill
  • damage resistance: 0.5 (takes 50% reduced damage from all sources)
  • size: 0.75 × 0.75 units

Damage resistance: takeDamage(double) multiplies incoming damage by (1 - damageResistance). This makes armoured enemies noticeably tougher against arrow towers but still vulnerable to cannon splash (high base damage cuts through). Because the cannon tower targets highest-HP enemies, armoured enemies are naturally prioritised by it — the intended synergy.

Abstract because render() from Entity is not implemented here; J2dArmoredEnemy extends this class and implements it.

  • Method Details

    • takeDamage

      public void takeDamage(double amount)
      Applies damage resistance before subtracting from health.

      With damageResistance = 0.5, an arrow tower's 15 damage becomes 7 effective damage and a cannon tower's 60 becomes 30. This makes the armoured enemy significantly tougher and encourages the player to invest in cannon towers for later waves.

      Overrides:
      takeDamage in class Enemy
      Parameters:
      amount - the raw incoming damage before resistance
